verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a cloud environment that a developer configures with repository dependencies and setup steps. Antigravity runs as a local desktop app and CLI. Its CLI sandbox (docs-48) is local mount-based isolation, not a reproducible cloud environment. Hooks (docs-21) and worktrees (docs-38) are adjacent features, and Remote Control (docs-26) drives desktop sessions on the user's own machines. None of these deliver this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure a reproducible cloud environment with the dependencies and setup steps my repository needs
